_about: Cards and rules that are implemented approximately, not like the original. Key = English card name (or 'RULE: ...'). Edit this file, then run tools/list_approximations.py to regenerate docs/APPROXIMATIONS.md. tests/test_approximations.gd checks that every card name here exists.

Magic Thorn.gap: Also triggers on discards paid as a cost, not only discards caused by Spell/Trap/Effect Monster effects.
Magic Thorn.fix: Tag the discard reason (cost vs effect) and only count effect discards.

Magical Hats.gap: The two decoys are tokens; the original takes 2 non-monster cards out of the Deck.
Magical Hats.fix: Move two Spell/Trap cards from the Deck onto the field as 0/0 monsters, return them afterwards.

Red-Moon Baby.gap: The destroyed monster comes back immediately, not at the end of the Battle Phase, and always in Attack Position.
Red-Moon Baby.fix: Queue the revival for the end of the Battle Phase and let the player pick the position.

Jirai Gumo.fix: A 'call it' prompt before the toss.

Insect Queen.gap: The Insect Monster Token appears immediately, not at the end of the turn.
Insect Queen.fix: Create the token in the End Phase.

Aqua Spirit.gap: The Standby Phase position-change effect is missing (only the special summon condition is in).
Aqua Spirit.fix: A trigger on the opponent's Standby Phase that lets the owner change one face-up monster's position.

The Rock Spirit.gap: The +300 ATK during the opponent's Battle Phase is missing.
The Rock Spirit.fix: A static modifier that depends on the current phase/turn.

Soul of Purity and Light.gap: The -300 ATK to the opponent's monsters during their Battle Phase is missing.
Soul of Purity and Light.fix: A static modifier that depends on the current phase/turn.

Spirit of Flames.gap: The +300 ATK during my Battle Phase is missing.
Spirit of Flames.fix: A static modifier that depends on the current phase/turn.

Dark Necrofear.gap: Only the special summon condition is in; the 'becomes an Equip Card and takes control' effect is missing.
Dark Necrofear.fix: Use become_equip plus a control link when destroyed.

Toon Summoned Skull.gap: The 'attack directly while the opponent controls no Toon monster' rule is missing.
Toon Summoned Skull.fix: Use the direct_vs_attributes style rule with a Toon-monster check.

Toon Mermaid.gap: The 'attack directly while the opponent controls no Toon monster' rule is missing.

Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon.gap: The 'attack directly while the opponent controls no Toon monster' rule is missing.

Mask of Dispel.gap: The card is only destroyed at the next Standby Phase after the selected Spell leaves the field.
Mask of Dispel.fix: A trigger on the selected card leaving the field.

Cyber Jar.gap: Summon positions and the order in which the two players pick up cards are simplified.
Cyber Jar.fix: Check the original's order and which player's monsters are summoned first.

Morphing Jar #2.gap: Rules/counts now follow native handler 0058c490: count all Main Deck returns by owner, stop on any excavated monster, summon only eligible Level 4 or lower monsters, and conceal multiple newly Set monsters by shuffling their occupied positions. Excavation uses a 0.45-second face-up preview and a 0.35-second position shuffle; these visual timings/path are reconstructed without a reference clip.
Morphing Jar #2.fix: Compare an original Morphing Jar #2 resolution video to match the excavation display and face-down position shuffle choreography/timing.

Exchange.gap: The hands are not shown to both players.

Last Will.gap: Implemented as a continuous effect for the turn; needs checking against the original timing.

Dream Clown.gap: Only triggers when the player changes its position, not when an effect does.
Dream Clown.fix: Fire position_changed from force_position too (with a flag for effect-caused changes).

Sinister Serpent.gap: Returning to the hand is automatic instead of optional.

Ground Collapse.gap: Only zones on the opponent's side can be blocked, and an occupied choice moves to the next free zone automatically.
Ground Collapse.fix: A zone-picker UI for either side.

Destiny Board.gap: The Spirit Message cards can still be played or Set by hand; only the board places them properly.
Destiny Board.fix: Forbid playing/Setting the Spirit Message cards manually.

Earthshaker.gap: The opponent's choice is labelled 'First/Second' instead of showing the two attributes.
Earthshaker.fix: Pass the chosen attribute names into the choice labels.

DNA Surgery.gap: Monster Type icons in the interface do not change.
DNA Surgery.fix: Use Duel.race_of in the card detail panel.

Valkyrion the Magna Warrior.gap: Only the summon condition is in; the rest of the card text has not been read for details.
Valkyrion the Magna Warrior.fix: Check the full original text and effects.

Alligator's Sword Dragon.gap: Face-down opposing monsters count as their real attribute when deciding if a direct attack is allowed.
Alligator's Sword Dragon.fix: Check what the original does with face-down monsters.

Polymerization.gap: 'Goddess with the Third Eye' / 'Versago the Destroyer' can be picked for more than one material slot.
Polymerization.fix: Allow at most one substitute per Fusion.

Fusion Gate.gap: Only used through an effect button; the original may offer it automatically.

Black Illusion Ritual.gap: Relinquished's special effect is missing (it is only a 0/0 monster).
Black Illusion Ritual.fix: Implement Relinquished (equip and take over ATK/DEF).

Relinquished.fix: Implement the equip and stat takeover.

Slate Warrior.gap: The penalty applies to whoever destroys it in battle, including in a mutual destruction.
Slate Warrior.fix: Check the original for mutual destruction.

Shift.gap: Redirects only to my other monsters, and is limited to monster attacks (not Spell/Trap targets).
Shift.fix: Add target_declared events for Spell/Trap targeting.

Dark Spirit of the Silent.gap: The original target is retained, as confirmed by FUN_0058dcc0. The forced position change is still quiet; exact position-change response timing needs tracing.
Dark Spirit of the Silent.fix: Trace FUN_005751e0 and the queued attack commands before changing position response windows.

Wall of Illusion.gap: Sent back to the hand after damage calculation using a flag; edge cases with multiple attackers untested.

Return of the Doomed.gap: The Spell Card stays face-up on the field until the End Phase instead of going to the Graveyard right away.
Return of the Doomed.fix: A delayed end-of-turn effect that is not tied to a card on the field.

Gilasaurus.gap: The 'treat as Special Summon' choice only marks the card as Special Summoned (the Normal Summon of the turn is still used).
Gilasaurus.fix: Let the summon dialog offer Special Summon, which would not use the Normal Summon.

Respect Play.gap: The card has no effect: the hand reveal is only a display matter and needs an interface.
Respect Play.fix: Show the other player's hand while the card is face-up (board view).

Kotodama.gap: Only the 'later copy is destroyed' rule is in; the 'two copies played at the same time are both destroyed' case is not.
Kotodama.fix: Detect simultaneous summons (Fusion Gate / Cyber Jar) and destroy both.

Big Shield Gardna.gap: The face-down single-target Spell negation is implemented. The shift to Attack Position still happens at Battle Phase end rather than immediately after the individual Damage Step; exact native position-event order needs tracing.
Big Shield Gardna.fix: Spell targets in the chain link, and a post-Damage-Step window.

Solomon's Lawbook.gap: Implemented as 'skip my next draw'; other Standby Phase effects of mine still happen.
Solomon's Lawbook.fix: Skip the whole Standby Phase of my next turn.

Riryoku.gap: The ATK change lasts until the end of the turn (the card text gives no duration).

Infinite Dismissal.gap: Destroys every Level 3 or lower monster summoned (Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Set) during the turn, including ones summoned before the trap was activated.
Infinite Dismissal.fix: Only count monsters summoned after the activation.

The Eye of Truth.gap: The hand reveal is missing (interface); only the +1000 LP effect is in.
The Eye of Truth.fix: Show the other player's hand while the card is face-up (board view).

Ceremonial Bell.gap: No effect: the hand reveal is only a display matter and needs an interface.
Ceremonial Bell.fix: Show both hands while the card is face-up (board view).

De-Fusion.gap: Revival is now optional, each material has a position choice, and the activating player's Graveyard is used. Material eligibility still matches the printed Fusion recipe rather than recording the actual cards used, including substitutes.
De-Fusion.fix: Trace the native material-history flags in FUN_00599e30 and persist actual Fusion materials.

The Flute of Summoning Dragon.gap: Needs a free Monster Card Zone for every Dragon; extra ones fail silently.
The Flute of Summoning Dragon.fix: Limit the selection to the number of free zones.

Lord of D..gap: Selection-based Dragon targeting protection is implemented. Completeness of target classification across individual effect scripts has not been audited; attacks and effects without targets correctly remain eligible.
Lord of D..fix: Audit targeting steps against FUN_0056c510 without extending protection to attacks or effects without targets.

Tailor of the Fickle.gap: The new host is selected before the chain and checked against the Equip effect's race/Attribute/side restrictions. Special native host predicates for revival and monster Equip Cards are not fully ported.
Tailor of the Fickle.fix: Port the remaining Equip-specific predicates from FUN_0056fc50; preserve them when moving the Equip.

Dimensionhole.gap: The Monster Card Zone is not reserved while the monster is removed from play, and the monster comes back as a Special Summon.
Dimensionhole.fix: Reserve the zone and return the monster without a summon.

Sword of Dragon's Soul.gap: The Dragon is destroyed when the Battle Phase ends (entering Main Phase 2 or ending the turn).
Sword of Dragon's Soul.fix: Verify the timing against the original.

Shadow of Eyes.gap: Works once, as a normal Trap, for the monster that was just Set.
Shadow of Eyes.fix: Check the original: continuous or one-shot.

Metal Detector.gap: The negated Continuous Trap stays on the field with its effects switched off until the end of the turn (it is not destroyed); same for Mystic Probe, World Suppression and Armored Glass.
Metal Detector.fix: Check what the original does to the negated card.

Riryoku Field.gap: 'Designates 1 monster' means the Spell's target step ended with exactly 1 monster selected; Spells that affect monsters without a target step are not detected.
Riryoku Field.fix: Mark target-style Spells explicitly in the effect data.

Weather Report.gap: Only the destruction of Swords of Revealing Light is in; the extra Battle Phase is missing.
Weather Report.fix: Let Duel run the Battle Phase twice after the flag is set.

Call of the Dark.gap: Only the ban on playing Monster Reborn is in; monsters already restored with Monster Reborn are not sent to the Graveyard.
Call of the Dark.fix: Remember which Special Summons came from Monster Reborn.

Harpie Lady Sisters.gap: Cannot be Normal Summoned, but other Special Summons (not only Elegant Egotist) are not blocked.
Harpie Lady Sisters.fix: A summon-procedure rule like Wall Shadow's.

Spellbinding Circle.gap: The card is also destroyed when the selected monster is offered as a Tribute (the original keeps it).
Spellbinding Circle.fix: Tell Tributes apart from other ways of leaving the field.

Ancient Telescope.gap: No effect: seeing the opponent's top 5 cards needs an interface.

Stim-Pack.gap: The -200 ATK per Standby Phase stays on the monster if the Equip Card leaves the field (also Germ Infection, -300).
Stim-Pack.fix: Tie the decrease to the Equip Card (a counter on it).

Kazejin.gap: The once-only ATK reduction is tracked per time the card is on the field (also Sanga of the Thunder).
Kazejin.fix: Remember the use across leaving the field if the original does.

Gate Guardian.gap: Can only be Special Summoned from the hand with its three Tributes; other Special Summons are not blocked.

Zone Eater.gap: 'The fifth turn after the attack' is counted in game turns of both players (also Swordsman from a Foreign Land and Steel Scorpion).
Zone Eater.fix: Verify the turn counting with the original.

Trap Master.gap: A face-up card of the wrong kind can be selected and nothing happens (also Reaper of the Cards, Armed Ninja, De-Spell).
Trap Master.fix: Restrict the selection to face-down cards and face-up cards of the right kind.

Thousand-Eyes Restrict.gap: A face-down monster should give 0 ATK/DEF; it gives its printed values. The stats are the equipped monster's printed ones.

Fake Trap.gap: The substitution is automatic whenever the opponent's effect would destroy my other Trap Card; there is no choice and it also works face-up.
Fake Trap.fix: Offer the choice and require the card to be Set.

Mystical Refpanel.gap: A Spell 'targets 1 player' if its effect damages, heals, draws, mills or discards for a player; the effect is swapped as a whole.

Fairy's Hand Mirror.gap: The new target must satisfy the Spell's own target filter; extra restrictions of Equip Cards are not re-checked.
Fairy's Hand Mirror.fix: Reuse the Equip Card's host legality check.

Pumpking the King of Ghosts.gap: The Standby Phase counter is reset only at the next Standby Phase after Castle of Dark Illusions leaves the field.
Pumpking the King of Ghosts.fix: Reset the counter when the Castle leaves.

Hourglass of Courage.gap: The doubling is computed from the printed ATK/DEF (other bonuses are not doubled).

Minar.gap: Only effects that go through the standard 'discard', 'mill' and 'to_grave' steps count as the opponent's effect (also Electric Snake, Penguin Knight).
Minar.fix: Set Duel.effect_player in every custom op that moves cards.

RULE: hand limit 6.gap: The 6-card hand limit is an assumption from the tutorial text.
RULE: hand limit 6.fix: Find it in the original's code.

RULE: three tributes for the Gods.gap: The Egyptian Gods need 3 tributes by assumption.

RULE: only 1 attack restriction on turn.gap: 'No attack on the first turn' follows what you told me; the exact original rule (also for the second player's first turn) is not verified.

RULE: spell speed.gap: Chains follow normal spell-speed rules; the original's response-window rules (who may respond when) are only partly verified.
RULE: spell speed.fix: Finish docs/DUEL_FLOW.md from the original's code.

RULE: windows.gap: 'Continuous card played' (strings 193-195) and the exact order of the 31 announced windows are not all implemented.

RULE: Quick-Play Spells.gap: A Set Quick-Play Spell can only be played in the response windows the engine opens (summons, attacks, target declaration, damage step, chain links, Standby and End Phase).
RULE: Quick-Play Spells.fix: Open a window whenever a player gets priority.

RULE: Who destroyed a card.gap: The player responsible for a destruction is only known for the plain 'destroy' effect step (Gust, Driving Snow, Fairy Guardian); custom effects (Crush Card, Cyber Jar, ...) report none.
RULE: Who destroyed a card.fix: Set Duel.effect_player in every custom op that destroys cards.

RULE: AI.gap: About 60 per-card AI handlers (for cards that had no effects) fall back to 'use if harmless'; battle boosters are approximated.

RULE: remaining-effect native parity.gap: Major Riot now matches the recovered handler's available-card/zone summon-count clamp and controller-based bounce eligibility. Multi-step effect return-window timing remains unverified: queued returns open after the chain without a last-action check. Other batches 18-20 still use extracted text and period rulings where native dispatch has not been traced.
RULE: remaining-effect native parity.fix: Trace FUN_00581790 and native event delivery around FUN_0058bb10 before imposing a last-action timing rule.

RULE: random-result animation motion.gap: Dice and coin animations now use the extracted sprite strips, final faces, shadows and sounds, and pause resolution until the result is displayed. Flight paths, frame cadence and result hold times are reconstructed rather than copied from the native renderer.
RULE: random-result animation motion.fix: Trace the native coin/dice renderer frame order, positions and timing, then replace the reconstructed motion while keeping the recorded-result presentation barrier.

RULE: deck shuffle presentation.gap: Frame cycle, tick stages and motion follow native 00453540/00453560; wall-clock timing uses 60 updates per second (original update frequency unverified). Sound ID 0x1000000f currently uses card_move.
RULE: deck shuffle presentation.fix: Verify the original update frequency and sound-ID mapping with runtime evidence.

RULE: video animation reconstruction.gap: Eight original-game clips guide stage order, native textures, direction, geometry and durations (10fps, approximately 0.1s uncertainty). Smooth tween curves, RPS reveal/centering, banner yaw and effect-destruction fragment trajectories are reconstructed; exact native interpolation and particle renderer are not yet traced.
RULE: video animation reconstruction.fix: Compare higher-frame-rate captures or native renderer tick functions before claiming pixel-exact timing and particle trajectories.

RULE: Set animation clock.gap: Set circle rotation, scale, opacity envelope and eight staggered rising stars follow native 0044f370/0044f390. Playback maps the native 12-tick increment to 30 updates/sec (~0.71s), inferred from the 10fps reference rather than a traced native clock. Star radii use a separate deterministic visual RNG instead of consuming duel RNG.
RULE: Set animation clock.fix: Verify native update frequency with a higher-frame-rate capture; retain independent visual randomness so presentation cannot affect duel results.

RULE: summon and Tribute presentation cl.gap: Normal Summon now follows native 0044f9f0/0044fa10: fading card ghost, pixel-sized wrapped rainbow crop, tick*5/8 scrolling and cosine opacity. Tribute follows 00487040/00487060/004870b0: expanding/rotating gold ring, native white-card layers and staggered rising stars, Graveyard handoff at tick 248 while the afterimage finishes through tick 384. Durations (1.0s summon renderer plus 0.2s arrival pause; 1.2s Tribute renderer plus 0.15s Graveyard settle) are fitted to 10fps clips; native clock and externally held Tribute tick-128 pause are not traced. Visual star radii use independent deterministic randomness.
RULE: summon and Tribute presentation cl.fix: Verify native frame clock and Tribute tick-128 hold with higher-frame-rate playback or native event dispatch, preserving visual-only RNG and the asynchronous Graveyard handoff.

RULE: smooth battle presentation.gap: Battle phase and attack stages follow recovered 00480c20/00480c60, 00414110/004142c0 and 004514b0 plus a 60fps recording of the original (docs/BATTLE_TIMING_NATIVE.md section 7): sword travel 0.25s, impact ring 0.47s, 1.06s quiet damage step, survivor shine 0.30s + 0.69s, damage number over the damaged player's monster with 1.15s hold, LP countdown at 30 steps/s, 0.33s pause, then star+puffs destruction (0.75s) and Graveyard. The recording is one case (attacker destroyed, attacker's controller damaged); timing for other cases (no-damage kills, double destruction, direct attacks) reuses the same stage lengths, and simultaneous destructions start together. No audio was captured, so sound onsets are not verified.
RULE: smooth battle presentation.fix: Record more battle cases (direct attack, defence-position kill, mutual destruction) with audio and compare stage lengths.

RULE: duel opening presentation clock.gap: Opening now uses a horizontal-strip reveal from the live Janken scene, native 00451950/00451980 title scale/opacity stages, and native 00418b60 sine-eased card-center movement, linear size interpolation and continuous flip into hand. Durations and 16px transition-strip spacing are fitted to the 10fps duelstart clip; native transition rasterization and update clock are unverified. Motion is evaluated every rendered frame, never limited to recording FPS. Opponent cards slide into their upside-down resting hand without rotating in flight. The opponent Deck uses the reference vertical flip (KONAMI bottom-left); matching the precise native back projection between Deck and hand remains unverified.
RULE: duel opening presentation clock.fix: Verify strip renderer and clock against higher-frame-rate native playback; retain sequential presentation acknowledgements and independent game RNG.

RULE: activation and effect destruction.gap: Activation, target confirmation, effect destruction and resolved-card Graveyard flight now wait for their preceding visual stage. Native 00450590/004505d0 pulse and counter-rotation are interpolated continuously; extracted shine supplies destruction core. Durations (0.6s flare, 0.4s selection, 0.75s fragments, 0.4s Graveyard flight) fit the low-FPS reference; particle breakup uses deterministic texture fragments instead of the original software rasterizer. Native exact compositing and update clock remain unverified.
RULE: activation and effect destruction.fix: Compare higher-frame-rate native playback for duration and particle refinement while preserving sequential visual barriers and independent game RNG.

RULE: responsive battle feedback.gap: Target clicks now launch swords immediately with simultaneous aiming/travel; unused red cursor and target-hover orb are disabled. Phase panels flip individually from outgoing to incoming color, staggered top-to-bottom using the extracted sprite sheet. Battle destruction has no shake (SHAKE_DURATION 0.0, matching the 60fps recording; the optional shake remains configurable) and a completion-driven Graveyard handoff. Flip stagger and shake interpolation are reconstructed from the low-FPS references; exact native raster projection and clock remain unverified. Damage/healing-number timing is tracked separately under LP and damage-number animation clock.
RULE: responsive battle feedback.fix: Refine panel projection and shake from higher-frame-rate native playback; preserve immediate input feedback and sequential resolution barriers.

RULE: LP and damage-number animation clo.gap: LP numbers use native 004806f0 right-to-left stagger, full-height hop and quarter-height rebound, followed by native 0047c560 remaining-delta countdown in 100/10/1 steps synchronized with displayed LP and clipped bar. Native default coordinates are (525,140)/(525,460). Timing maps native updates to 60Hz (0.533s entry); native clock is unverified because supplied portrait video is sped up and crops the left LP panel. Blue healing uses the same recovered native renderer although no healing occurs in the clip. Engine LP values and RNG are unchanged.
RULE: LP and damage-number animation clo.fix: Confirm normal-speed native clock and LP-panel motion with an uncropped reference; retain render-rate digit interpolation and event-by-event displayed LP synchronization.

RULE: Deck editor collection drawer.gap: Uses original panel, filter, sorting and card-info sprites. Drawer motion uses a smooth 0.30-second tween inferred from screenshots; exact original duration is unverified. Sorts attack/defense/level descending, type/attribute ascending with alphabetical ties; original tie ordering is unverified. Expanded names use the current UI font. Preview typography uses Arial and Arial Black matched visually to screenshots; exact original font settings remain unverified.
RULE: Deck editor collection drawer.fix: Compare an original deck-editor video and native sorting tables to refine motion duration, font and tie ordering.

Twin-Headed Wolf.gap: A Flip monster it attacks face-down is judged when it flips: its Flip Effect is skipped if the current ATK beats its DEF. Damage Step boosts played afterwards do not change that (the engine resolves Flip Effects before damage, the TCG after).
Twin-Headed Wolf.fix: Resolve Flip Effects of monsters flipped by an attack after damage calculation, then negate them if the monster was destroyed.

Dark Ruler Ha Des.gap: Same Flip Effect timing as Twin-Headed Wolf; Graveyard effects of its battle victims are negated for the rest of that turn.

Dark Balter the Terrible.gap: Flip Effect timing as Twin-Headed Wolf.
Dark Balter the Terrible.fix: Resolve Flip Effects of monsters flipped by an attack after damage calculation, then negate them if the monster was destroyed.

Tyrant Dragon.gap: When it is Special Summoned from the Graveyard, the Dragon to Tribute is chosen automatically (the one with the lowest ATK).
Tyrant Dragon.fix: Ask the summoning player to pick the Dragon (needs a decision inside Duel.special_summon).

Heart of Clear Water.gap: 'Effects that target the monster' means a destroy step on a selected card; mass destruction never counts as targeting.
Heart of Clear Water.fix: Mark which selections are targets in the effect data and check that flag.

Patrician of Darkness.gap: The opponent first declares an attack on one of your monsters, then you pick the real target (it redirects the attack).
Patrician of Darkness.fix: Let the Patrician's controller pick the target in the attack declaration UI.

Soul Demolition.gap: Its effect can only be used during your own Main Phase.
Soul Demolition.fix: Allow the effect as a speed-2 Quick Effect in any response window.

A Feint Plan.gap: Both players are affected ('A player cannot attack face-down monsters').
A Feint Plan.fix: Confirm against the original whether it binds only the opponent.
